motor.name: SunnySky V3508 580KV
motor.qualification: Drawing revision must be checked against purchased motor. No radial-load rating published.

fasteners.qualification: Bottoming screen only. Thread strength, usable full threads, preload and loosening remain open.

parts.name: motor_mount_plate
parts.note: 3 mm aluminum, Ø56 mm, four motor screws and three support screws. Custom flat part; quote/thermal path pending.

parts.name: motor_stator
parts.note: Simplified non-rotating motor body. Aggregate motor mass is 97 g, not this solid's bulk density.

parts.name: motor_rotor_and_shaft
parts.note: Conservative bell/shaft shape; exact shaft projections retained. No assumed long output shaft or gearbox.

parts.name: motor_winding_envelope
parts.note: Internal appearance envelope only, included in the single purchased 97 g motor.

limitations: Motor envelope and mounting are from a manufacturer drawing; simplified internal geometry cannot supply actual inertia or bearing spacing.
No manufacturer radial load, rotor bell strength or shaft retention qualification for wheel use.
Encoder PCB, magnet, fastening, closed shin support and sealing are allocations, not a completed assembly.
Wheel elasticity, hub creep, bending and impact strength remain unmeasured.
The 200 mm tire width exceeds the 180 mm working target. Compactness must be checked over the full leg branch, not just ride pose.
